fields.label: Location
fields.description: City or area of the project; full address is optional
fields.question: Which city or area is your project in?

fields.label: Permit
fields.description: Building permit status; never infer approval from a drawing
fields.question: Have you started the permit process, or is that still ahead?

fields.label: Budget
fields.description: Approximate budget range with currency, or still exploring
fields.question: Do you have a rough budget in mind? It is fine if you are still exploring.

fields.label: Square footage
fields.description: Project area, including units and whether approximate
fields.question: Roughly how much space are you planning? An estimate is absolutely fine.

fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Desired rooms, floors, or space requirements
fields.question: What sort of layout or rooms would you like?

fields.label: Blueprints
fields.description: Whether plans exist; file receipt is tracked separately under attachments
fields.question: Do you already have plans? If so, a screenshot or link is fine.

fields.label: Available time
fields.description: Preferred consultation time and timezone, not the construction start date
fields.question: Is there a day or time that is usually convenient for a short call?

fields.label: Lot area
fields.description: Area of an already owned plot of land, with units if provided. Separate from desired house floor area (square_footage); never copy one into the other.
fields.question: About how large is your lot? Sq ft, square metres or acres are all fine; you can skip this if you’re not sure.
